# Tcl Language Standard --- Command Index

*Auto-generated by `tools/mkindex.tcl` from
`tcl_language_standard_v1.md`, `th8_language_extensions.md`, and
`src/plugins/th8_*.c`.  Do not edit by hand; re-run the tool
after changes to any of these sources.*

This document is a navigation aid for the formal
**Tcl Language Standard**.  Every command in the language
is listed here with a pointer to the section that
specifies its normative requirements, plus the plugin
category that registers it (and the compile-time gate
that controls its inclusion).

Section pointers may target either the base language standard
(`tcl_language_standard_v1.md`) or the TH8-specific extensions
document (`th8_language_extensions.md`).  Commands under the
`harpy` plugin are defined in the extensions document; all
other plugins' commands are in the base standard.

Commands without a section pointer (`?`) are registered by
a plugin but not yet specified in either document --- they
are listed for completeness and identify standardisation
work still to be done.

---
